description:
Thirty years in appliance service. Now on your side of the invoice.

I'm Walt Brennan. I spent my career fixing refrigerators, washers and dryers — and eight of those years in the office, training the technicians who knock on your door. This channel is the half of the conversation nobody volunteers: what a repair should actually cost, what your warranty really covers, which parts fail and why, and the exact words to say to the man standing in your kitchen.

Every price and every claim comes with a named source. If I can't check it, I don't say it.

New video every week.
